Maya (CSM): kicking off Verdance Health onboarding handoff. goal: get a clean pilot and surface any renewal blockers early. quick go/no-go checklist?
Evelyn (Account Lead): adding context: procurement has a 60-day payment SLA, renewal window in ~11 months. ill lead exec syncs. main risks: delayed payment, security review, low pilot engagement.
Ravi (Success Eng): technical owners: Priya for KMS/secrets, Victor (infra) for VPC peering. ill run integration tests once keys are ready.
Priya (DevOps): noted. need environment diagram from their infra team and a list of IP ranges. also confirm whether they want HSM for keys.
Maya (CSM): proposed success metrics: "Day 30: 3 production routes live", "Day 30: median p50 latency <250ms", "Pilot NPS >= 30", "Enablement: 1 recorded session + docs". open to edits.
Jordan (Product Enablement): suggest adding adoption signal: 100 monthly active internal users across their apps by day 60. training should include prompt hygiene + cost controls.
Evelyn (Account Lead): add SLA sign-off: they requested 99.9% for critical endpoints. legal is reviewing.
Maya (CSM): draft timeline: ```
Day 0-2: creds, scoping, stakeholder list
Day 3-9: infra setup (VPC, IP allowlist, KMS)
Day 10-16: integration + smoke tests + latency baseline
Day 17-21: enablement (recording + live Q&A)
Day 22-60: pilot expansion, usage ramps, cost tuning
Day 60: pilot review + production roll decision
```
Ravi (Success Eng): quick tech checklist snippet: ```
- API keys and least-privilege scopes
- IP allowlist & routing test
- Example prompts + expected outputs (seed set)
- KV cache prefs configured per app
- Run: ./scripts/latency_benchmark.sh --rps 50 --seq 128
```
CS Bot: Onboarding template for Verdance: https://intranet.redwood/CS/onboards/verdance-template (auto-post) :bookmark_tabs:
Maya (CSM): feedback capture plan: shared spreadsheet for prompt-level issues + weekly demo where product team rates outputs. any quality regression -> open incident for research/ops.
Priya (DevOps): reqs for security review: SOC2 attestation, KMS flow, and app network diagram. please collect before Day 3.
Evelyn (Account Lead): renewal risk flags to monitor: procurement lag, >10% cost over forecast, <20% adoption in pilot. escalate to me for any of the above.
Jordan (Product Enablement): i'll prep a 12-min recording and a quick 1-pager with best-practice prompts + token budgeting tips.
Maya (CSM): action items (condensed): - Priya: request infra diagram from Verdance by EOD tomorrow - Ravi: post integration checklist & test script by EOD - Jordan: record training by Fri - Evelyn: coordinate exec cadence and procurement timeline - Maya: calendar weekly standup invite and shared feedback doc
Ravi (Success Eng): sharing quick curl smoke test for initial run: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" -d '{"input":"Summarize patient intake form"}'```
Maya (CSM): tagging follow-ups: if procurement or security slips, mark as "moderate" renewal risk and notify Evelyn. otherwise default to "green" until we see blockers. :white_check_mark:
Evelyn (Account Lead): sounds good. i'll loop in finance + legal and report back by Tue. thanks team. :rocket:
Maya (CSM): thanks all see you on the kickoff call Tue 10am.
